item.title: Snow to stay north
item.description: NARROW BAND OF SNOW wraps over the plains during the day on Saturday.Kansas City has a 0% chance of any snow from this system.If you live in northern & northeast Missouri, images 2 and 3 will help you know what to expect by Saturday night / Sunday morning.3" on the high side in very NE Missouri only.-Greg@660weather

item.description: The department is asking for the public's assistance with helping to identify this person. One dog has already been picked up again. If you have any information please call the Bates County Sheriff's Office dispatch to get a hold of an officer.

item.title: The Wall That Heals: Your help is needed!
item.description: We are blessed to live in such a great community. In just three short weeks we have raised $20,150. Even though we have met our original goal, we will still be accepting monetary donations in any amount. Because, truthfully, we do not know exactly what our total expenses will be.
